visible_text: In the figure, O is the centre of the semicircle PBQ. The line PQ is tangent to circle ABC at point O. Given that ∠BPQ = 12°, find the measure of ∠BAC. Options: (A) 18°, (B) 24°, (C) 36°, (D) 54°.
reasoning: Since OP = OB, triangle OPB is isosceles, giving ∠QOB = 24°. By the Power of a Point theorem and the Law of Cosines we find ∠POC = 12°. The Alternate Segment Theorem then yields ∠OAB = 24° and ∠OAC = 12°, so ∠BAC = ∠OAB + ∠OAC = 36°, which corresponds to option C.
